defense_identity.note: v2.py git blob matches the foundation exactly; the foundation's SHA-256 was taken on a Windows/CRLF checkout, so the platform-independent (LF) content SHA-256 differs. Canonical identity: the git blob OID. Pending Ahsan's confirmation.

controls.length: V2 rejects input whose TOKEN count exceeds the model limit, checked before inference. This is a post-parse token-length gate, NOT an HTTP/wire body-size limit.
controls.strict_type_schema: V2 uses StrictStr + extra='forbid' on the request model; wrong types, missing/unknown fields and incompatible body shapes are rejected.
controls.normalization: V2 applies NFKC + control/format-character stripping + whitespace collapse before inference.

cross_cutting_note: The scoped exception handler (C3) is cross-cutting. Its observable responses are evaluated, but it is never listed in controls_targeted and never attributed as causal coverage by length/schema/normalization. A clean rejection may reflect framework/parser behaviour shared with V1, not V2 hardening.
classification_basis: attack construction + declared control design; never observed V1/V2 results

bidi_reorder.coverage_rationale: Bidi directional-format (Cf) controls; normalization strip is designed to remove them.

broken_json.coverage_rationale: Unparseable JSON; fails at JSON decoding before the declared controls (which see an already-parsed {text}) run. C3 may shape the response; no causal control attribution.

capitalization.coverage_rationale: Casing change in valid text; NFKC does not case-fold, so no declared control alters it -- model-level.

compatibility_fullwidth.coverage_rationale: Full-width compatibility characters; NFKC normalization is designed to fold them to ASCII.

compatibility_ligature.coverage_rationale: f-ligature compatibility characters; NFKC normalization is designed to fold them.

deeply_nested_json_d1024.coverage_rationale: Dual-purpose: parser-depth before validation; and object-typed `text` rejected by strict type/schema if it parses. Construction-based, not outcome-based.

deeply_nested_json_d128.coverage_rationale: Dual-purpose: parser-depth before validation; and object-typed `text` rejected by strict type/schema if it parses. Construction-based, not outcome-based.

deeply_nested_json_d2000.coverage_rationale: Dual-purpose: parser-depth before validation; and object-typed `text` rejected by strict type/schema if it parses. Construction-based, not outcome-based.

deeply_nested_json_d32.coverage_rationale: Dual-purpose by construction: (1) parser-depth/resource behaviour before validation; AND (2) if parsing succeeds, `text` is a nested object (not a string), which the strict type/schema control rejects. Not classified by observed outcome.

deeply_nested_json_d512.coverage_rationale: Dual-purpose: parser-depth before validation; and object-typed `text` rejected by strict type/schema if it parses. Construction-based, not outcome-based.

delete_char.coverage_rationale: Character deletion in valid text; no declared control alters it -- model-level.

deletion_backspace.coverage_rationale: Backspace (Cc) control chars; normalization strip is designed to remove them.

duplicate_text_keys.coverage_rationale: Duplicate `text` keys; RFC 8259 leaves duplicate-name behaviour to the parser, which resolves the structure before Pydantic can inspect it -- parser semantics, not the schema control.

empty_string.coverage_rationale: Valid empty text; no declared control alters or rejects an empty value.

extra_field.coverage_rationale: Unknown extra field beside valid text; V2 extra='forbid' is designed to reject it. This is the one case that differs from V1 (default 'ignore' accepts).

homoglyph.coverage_rationale: Cross-script Cyrillic confusables: by construction NFKC does NOT fold confusables (UTS #39 is separate from UAX #15) and they are letters, not control chars -- no declared control alters them; any effect is model-level.

homoglyph_greek.coverage_rationale: Cross-script Greek confusables: same NFKC gap as Cyrillic; no declared control alters them; any effect is model-level.

insert_char.coverage_rationale: Character insertion in valid text; no declared control alters it -- model-level.

interior_runs.coverage_rationale: Repeated interior spaces; normalization's whitespace collapse is designed to normalize them.

invisible_zero_width.coverage_rationale: Zero-width (category Cf) chars; normalization's control-char strip is designed to remove them.

keyboard_typo.coverage_rationale: Keyboard-neighbour typo in valid text; no declared control alters it -- model-level.

keyboard_typo_second_word.coverage_rationale: Keyboard-neighbour typo on a second content word; no declared control alters it -- model-level.

leading_trailing.coverage_rationale: Leading/trailing whitespace; normalization strip is designed to remove it.

length_at_limit.coverage_rationale: Text at the token limit; exercises the length-gate boundary. NOTE: exercises the POST-PARSE token-length gate, not an HTTP/wire body-size limit; Rayyan records exact serialized body bytes separately.

length_clearly_over.coverage_rationale: Approximate-mode fallback of length_plus_one: text over the token limit. NOTE: exercises the POST-PARSE token-length gate, not an HTTP/wire body-size limit; Rayyan records exact serialized body bytes separately.

length_clearly_under.coverage_rationale: Approximate-mode fallback of length_minus_one: text well under the token limit. NOTE: exercises the POST-PARSE token-length gate, not an HTTP/wire body-size limit; Rayyan records exact serialized body bytes separately.

length_minus_one.coverage_rationale: Text just under the token limit; exercises the length gate on the accept side. NOTE: exercises the POST-PARSE token-length gate, not an HTTP/wire body-size limit; Rayyan records exact serialized body bytes separately.

length_near_limit.coverage_rationale: Approximate-mode fallback of length_at_limit: text near the token limit. NOTE: exercises the POST-PARSE token-length gate, not an HTTP/wire body-size limit; Rayyan records exact serialized body bytes separately.

length_plus_one.coverage_rationale: Text just over the token limit; the length control is designed to reject it. NOTE: exercises the POST-PARSE token-length gate, not an HTTP/wire body-size limit; Rayyan records exact serialized body bytes separately.

malformed_utf8.coverage_rationale: Invalid UTF-8 bytes; decoding fails at the transport/parser layer before the declared controls.

missing_field.coverage_rationale: Required `text` absent; the schema/type validation surface governs it. Rejection is shared with V1 (base validation); NOT evidence of incremental V2 hardening.

misspell.coverage_rationale: Common misspelling in valid text; no declared control alters it -- model-level.

newlines.coverage_rationale: Newlines; normalization's whitespace collapse is designed to normalize them.

null_byte.coverage_rationale: NUL (Cc); normalization strip is designed to remove it.

oversized_100kb.coverage_rationale: Very large text value; once parsed it is exactly what the token-length control is designed to reject. NOTE: exercises the POST-PARSE token-length gate, not an HTTP/wire body-size limit; Rayyan records exact serialized body bytes separately.

oversized_10mb.coverage_rationale: Very large text value; once parsed it is exactly what the token-length control is designed to reject. NOTE: exercises the POST-PARSE token-length gate, not an HTTP/wire body-size limit; Rayyan records exact serialized body bytes separately.

oversized_1mb.coverage_rationale: Very large text value; once parsed it is exactly what the token-length control is designed to reject. NOTE: exercises the POST-PARSE token-length gate, not an HTTP/wire body-size limit; Rayyan records exact serialized body bytes separately.

repeat_char.coverage_rationale: Character repetition in valid text; no declared control alters it -- model-level.

repeated_punctuation.coverage_rationale: Repeated punctuation (not whitespace); no declared control removes punctuation; may shift intensity -- model-level.

signal_end_over_limit.coverage_rationale: Signal + long filler exceeding the token limit; the length control is designed to reject it before inference. NOTE: exercises the POST-PARSE token-length gate, not an HTTP/wire body-size limit; Rayyan records exact serialized body bytes separately.

signal_end_short.coverage_rationale: Under-limit valid text, signal at end; positional/semantic -- no declared control acts.

signal_head_only.coverage_rationale: Under-limit truncated head of the signal; no declared control acts -- model-level/diagnostic.

signal_start_over_limit.coverage_rationale: Signal + long filler exceeding the token limit; the length control is designed to reject it before inference. NOTE: exercises the POST-PARSE token-length gate, not an HTTP/wire body-size limit; Rayyan records exact serialized body bytes separately.

signal_start_short.coverage_rationale: Under-limit valid text, signal at start; positional/semantic -- no declared control acts.

signal_tail_only.coverage_rationale: Under-limit truncated tail of the signal; no declared control acts -- model-level/diagnostic.

single_char.coverage_rationale: Valid single-character text; no declared control acts.

single_space.coverage_rationale: Whitespace-only text; normalization is designed to collapse/strip it.

swap_adjacent.coverage_rationale: Adjacent-letter swap in valid text; no declared control alters it -- model-level.

tabs.coverage_rationale: Tabs; normalization's whitespace collapse is designed to normalize them.

top_level_array.coverage_rationale: JSON parses but the top-level value is an array, not the declared request object; schema/model validation rejects the body shape. Rejection is shared with V1 (base validation); NOT evidence of incremental V2 hardening.

top_level_number.coverage_rationale: Top-level JSON number, not the declared request object; schema/model validation rejects the body shape. Rejection is shared with V1 (base validation); NOT evidence of incremental V2 hardening.

top_level_string.coverage_rationale: Top-level JSON string, not the declared request object; schema/model validation rejects the body shape. Rejection is shared with V1 (base validation); NOT evidence of incremental V2 hardening.

trailing_garbage.coverage_rationale: Valid JSON followed by trailing non-JSON; rejected at the parser layer before the declared controls.

type_confusion_boolean.coverage_rationale: Non-string (boolean) for text; strict type/schema governs it. Rejection is shared with V1 (base validation); NOT evidence of incremental V2 hardening.

type_confusion_list.coverage_rationale: Non-string (array) for text; strict type/schema governs it. Rejection is shared with V1 (base validation); NOT evidence of incremental V2 hardening.

type_confusion_nested_object.coverage_rationale: Non-string (object) for text; strict type/schema governs it. Rejection is shared with V1 (base validation); NOT evidence of incremental V2 hardening.

type_confusion_null.coverage_rationale: Non-string (null) for text; the strict type/schema control governs it. Rejection is shared with V1 (base validation); NOT evidence of incremental V2 hardening.

type_confusion_number.coverage_rationale: Non-string (number) for text; strict type/schema governs it. Rejection is shared with V1 (base validation); NOT evidence of incremental V2 hardening.

unicode_spaces.coverage_rationale: Unicode space look-alikes; NFKC + whitespace collapse are designed to normalize them.

unusual_json_escapes.coverage_rationale: Valid JSON \u escapes that decode to ordinary text; the request is valid and no declared control alters it.

utf8_bom.coverage_rationale: UTF-8 BOM prefix; byte-level decoding at the transport/parser layer, before the declared controls.

word_split.coverage_rationale: A single space inserted inside a word; not a whitespace run, so normalization does not collapse it -- model-level.

wrong_content_type.coverage_rationale: Valid JSON body labelled text/plain; content-type handling is transport/framework layer, before the declared controls.

wrong_field_name.coverage_rationale: `txt` not `text`: required field missing + unknown field present; schema/type governs it. Rejection is shared with V1 (base validation); NOT evidence of incremental V2 hardening.
